narrator.label: Narrator
narrator.description: An articulate adult English narrator with warm authority and a thoughtful, varied cadence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: What happens when helping you get better means losing you as a customer?

direction.delivery: Conversational and immediately clear; give light emphasis to “get better / losing you”. Sound interested in the question, not as if revealing a secret.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Aspirin, Viagra, and Coffins uses dark humor to explore businesses built around human pain.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “dark humor”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some needs are urgent, some feel too private to discuss, and others arrive at the end of life.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “urgent / private / end of life”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The title opens a serious conversation about loneliness, exhaustion, shame, and the help people seek.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “help people seek”. Speak with care for the person involved; no pitying tone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A useful service can bring relief while its business depends on the problem continuing.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “problem continuing”. Let concern come from the situation; no alarm or dramatic drop in pitch.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book follows that tension through research, care, and the growing market for AI companions.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “AI companions”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its jokes make room for questions that polished sales pitches tend to avoid.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “questions”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: If a product promises to help, what should success look like for the person using it?

direction.delivery: Warm, unhurried closing; give light emphasis to “the person using it”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.
